culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Osamu Kuranishi. Akiyama after watching the news segment about the robbery that happened four years ago wanted to make things right. She had claimed that she had lost the original cards with the riddles on them so she made new ones, complete with pictures instead of sentences. In reality the new riddle cards she made is in fact a secret code, looking at the drawings at first glance they only seem to be hints to the next location.

motive.quote: But in actuality what he wanted was to take the watch she was wearing because it had been modified and embedded with a hidden camera.

method.quote: After he attacked her, later when they found her he pretended to be concerned and went to check on her.

evidence.quote: After he attacked her, later when they found her he pretended to be concerned and went to check on her.

motive.zhHans: 但实际上他想要的是拿走她戴着的那块手表，因为它经过改装，内嵌了一个隐藏的摄像头。知晓此事的Akiyama对她男友所犯下的罪行感到内疚，并试图劝说Kuranishi自首，这就是他想要让她闭嘴的原因。然而兰告诉他，Akiyama很不幸，因为她深爱并信任的男人却试图杀她，这让他羞愧得瘫倒在地。
motive.en: But in actuality what he wanted was to take the watch she was wearing because it had been modified and embedded with a hidden camera. Akiyama who knew about this, felt guilty of the crime her boyfriend had committed and tried to persuade Kuranishi to turn himself in which is why he tried to silence her. However Ran tells him Akiyama is unfortunate, because the man she loved and trusted tried to kill her causing him to crumble to the ground in shame.

method.zhHans: 他袭击她之后，后来人们发现她时，他装出关心的样子，上前去查看她的情况。
method.en: After he attacked her, later when they found her he pretended to be concerned and went to check on her.

evidence.zhHans: 他袭击她之后，后来人们发现她时，他装出关心的样子，上前去查看她的情况。
evidence.en: After he attacked her, later when they found her he pretended to be concerned and went to check on her.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Osamu Kuranishi。Akiyama在看了关于四年前那起抢劫案的新闻报道后，想要弥补过错。她曾声称自己弄丢了写有谜题的原始卡片，于是重新制作了新的卡片，用图画代替了文字。实际上，她制作的新谜题卡片正是一种秘密暗号，乍看之下这些图画似乎只是通往下一个地点的提示。但事实上，这些图画本身有着隐藏的含义。解开后，这些图画指出了四年前那起抢劫案的细节：日期、犯罪类型，以及最后的犯人。她想用这些新卡片向小五郎传递一条秘密信息，希望他能帮助她，但在他能够破解之前，她就被Kuranishi袭击了。
resolution.en: The culprit is Osamu Kuranishi. Akiyama after watching the news segment about the robbery that happened four years ago wanted to make things right. She had claimed that she had lost the original cards with the riddles on them so she made new ones, complete with pictures instead of sentences. In reality the new riddle cards she made is in fact a secret code, looking at the drawings at first glance they only seem to be hints to the next location. But in truth the drawings themselves actually had a hidden meaning. When decoded the drawings point out details from the robbery case that happened four years ago: the date, the type of crime, and finally the culprit. She wanted to use these new cards to send a secret message to Kogoro hoping he would help her, but before he could figure it out she was attacked by Kuranishi.
